name: Shop-A-Sketch
tagline: Draw the thing you want to buy and get matching real products with prices and store links.
problem: Shopping search is text-first, but people often picture a product they cannot describe in words.
solution: A drawing canvas sends the sketch to a multimodal model that extracts what was drawn; a layer applies the shopper's declared preferences, and live product search returns items with prices, ratings and merchant links, filterable by price.
demo_moment: Team-described: sketch an object and see purchasable matches seconds later.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Took third place overall among 160 submissions.
Built an end-to-end flow from a rough drawing to real products in seconds.
Draw-to-shop is one sentence and a five-second demo anyone in the room can try.

lessons: A narrow flow that finishes end to end can place against far heavier engineering.
